snapshot.body: Founded in 1976 in Barquisimeto, PYGLARA has spent nearly five decades protecting Venezuelan steel. We operate original W. Pilling Riepe GmbH equipment from Germany — the world reference manufacturer for galvanizing kettles — and have served over 34 companies across the electrical, telecommunications, construction, and agroindustrial sectors. galv_page.step1_desc: Removal of oils and surface contaminants with alkaline solution.
galv_page.step2_desc: Removal of mill scale and rust with hydrochloric acid (HCl) to activate the steel surface.
galv_page.step3_desc: Immersion in ammonium chloride (NH4Cl) solution to promote zinc adhesion.
galv_page.step4_desc: Immersion in molten zinc at 450 °C — Zinc SHG 99.99% purity.
galv_page.step5_desc: Controlled cooling and final finishing; visual and thickness inspection.
galv_page.kettles_caption: We select the appropriate kettle based on your workpiece dimensions and type.
galv_page.kettle_9m_callout: The only active galvanizer in Venezuela capable of processing workpieces longer than 7 meters.
galv_page.quality_body: Every order ships with a quality certificate under COVENIN 1212-81, ASTM A123, and ASTM A153. Per-lot certificates are issued by Ing. Miriam, with over 36 years of experience in industrial galvanizing.
galv_page.manufacturer_body: Our kettles are manufactured by W. Pilling Riepe GmbH (Germany), the world reference manufacturer for hot-dip galvanizing equipment. Precise tolerances, uniform zinc coating, consistent finish on every batch.
galv_page.hse_body: PYGLARA operates with industrial safety protocols for the handling of chemical substances (HCl, NH4Cl, molten zinc). Our facilities include mechanical ventilation in the kettle hall, personal protective equipment, and current emergency response plans.
